events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the sprawling masterpiece known as 'The White Album'. What's your favourite track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Queen Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, but Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and stage presence live on. A true icon of rock.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', marking a pivotal shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that changed everything. What's your go-to track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Music Icon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his timeless impact on music and beyond.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the innovative and influential musician and cultural icon, David Bowie.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the legend David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: King's Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His legacy is eternal.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist and songwriter for Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff he blessed us with?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass! The legendary Rod Stewart turns 82 today. What's your favourite hit from the raspy-voiced icon?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of the iconic British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs! Our house in the middle of our street is celebrating the Madness frontman today.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)' and 'Come Back and Stay', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of the 80s, Paul Young! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of the beloved American country music legend, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Country Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music and spirit shine on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Gary Barlow! What's your favourite Take That hit or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean King
angles.copy: Get out of our dreams and into our feed! Happy 77th Birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring pioneers of rock music.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, rock history was made with the first-ever Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who were you most excited to see inducted?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter and Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! What's your favourite memory of the band?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The English drummer, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! From Genesis to his solo hits, what's your top track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the Prince of Pop, Justin Timberlake! What's your favourite JT banger?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved English actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter in Only Fools and Horses and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Poplar, his characters are simply iconic.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, American rock and roll musicians Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and 'The Big Bopper' J.P. Richardson died in a plane crash, an event later known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost three legends in 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The English singer, songwriter, and musician Rick Astley, known for his 80s hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to Rick Astley! We're never gonna give him up on his special day.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of the iconic Jamaican singer, songwriter, and reggae pioneer Bob Marley.

angles.name: Reggae Legend
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Remembering Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The American singer-songwriter and musician Carole King, one of the most successful female songwriters of all time, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Songwriting Queen
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the brilliant Carole King! Her songs have shaped generations of music. What's your favourite?
